title: PRC With Meniscal Allograft Arthroplasty for Wrist Osteoarthritis
official: Proximal Row Carpectomy With Meniscal Allograft Arthroplasty for Wrist Osteoarthritis
summary: This study plans to learn more about the effect of adding tissue graft for wrist osteoarthritis reconstruction procedures. Previous studies have shown better allograft stability, and no documented foreign body reaction than with silicone and other synthetic materials.

interventions.name: Meniscus Allograft Transplantation with Proximal Row Carpectomy

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* symptomatic wrist arthritis associated with SLAC or SNAC pathology
* Patients 30 years or older or 80 years or younger

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients younger than 29 years or older than 80 years
* History of previous surgery related to wrist osteoarthritis
